gaps.title: The synthesis of Brain outputs is not validated
gaps.whyItMatters: Intelligence assembles inputs; no cross-Brain relationship has been tested against outcomes, so it cannot recommend.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether the app may say anything beyond showing each factor with its age and label.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when a cross-Brain relationship holds on independent data, or field outcomes are required.
gaps.expectedOutput: A tested relationship, or a recorded refusal.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Field outcomes paired with the Brain states at the time.

gaps.title: Input requirement is declared REQUIRED in one file and OPTIONAL in another
gaps.whyItMatters: The catalog marks the five inputs required while the control manifest marks them optional, so abstain behaviour depends on which file is read.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether the app shows a partial picture or nothing when one input is stale.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when both files agree and a test pins it.

gaps.title: Dependencies the Brains use are not declared in brain.json
gaps.whyItMatters: Fish reads five Brains but declares none; Water Temp and Clarity also read an undeclared input (recorded in integration_contract_gaps.json).
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether a stale input is noticed by the orchestrator.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when the recorded list is empty.
gaps.expectedOutput: Declared consumes for every used input.
